note: Run with tests/run_case.py; grade by tests/AGENT-TEST.md. Fixtures are fictional.

cases.prompt: /sdops:ds-ux-patterns Document the home screen of our app as a UX pattern. The screen notes are in screens/home.md. Write the catalogue as Markdown here.
expect: Reads README.md or the screen notes before asking, and does not ask for anything they already answer (product name, platform, screen size)
Asks one question at a time (at most one question per turn, or one bundled confirmation)
Offers a proposed default with each question and says why it asks
Proposes an ID in the PROD-PLT-#### shape (e.g. LUMN-IOS-0001) and asks to confirm it
Does not require a Figma connection for a Markdown run from local notes

cases.prompt: /sdops:ds-ux-patterns Document the 'Book a stay' flow from screens/booking-flow.md as Markdown in this folder. I don't know the codename, the owner or the approver: skip those.
expect: Writes TBD for codename, owner and approver; never invents a name
Keeps the pattern status proposed
Adds an Open questions section to the pattern listing the TBDs
Records branch 3a, entry points and exit from the notes
Does not stop the run because of the TBDs; writes the files
Shows a proposal table before writing

cases.prompt: /sdops:ds-ux-patterns Add the settings page to our Figma pattern library: https://www.figma.com/design/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA/Lumen-Patterns
expect: Notices no Figma connector answers
Gives plain setup steps naming /mcp and the Figma Desktop Bridge plugin
Says the run is blocked on the designer and writes nothing

cases.prompt: /sdops:ds-ux-patterns Update the pattern catalogue in ux-patterns/ with the new Saved screen (screens/saved.md).
expect: Reads ux-patterns/index.md before numbering and reuses its conventions (codename HALO, LUMN-IOS)
Numbers the new pattern LUMN-IOS-0005
Does not re-ask what the index already answers (owner, approver, modules)
Shows the proposal table before writing
Links the new pattern to existing ones where they apply (e.g. 0003 or 0004 for states)
Updates the index and its Next free ID

cases.prompt: /sdops:ds-ux-patterns Also document our checkout and refund flows as Markdown here.
expect: Says there is no screen for the refund flow and asks for one instead of inventing it
Does not write a refund pattern without evidence
Treats checkout as covered by the booking flow notes or asks, rather than inventing a new one

cases.prompt: Can you help me write down the UX patterns of our app? The screen notes are in screens/.
expect: Loads the sdops:ds-ux-patterns skill without being told its name
